title: McDonald's Sun Coast Christmas 2005 Plate - Hamburglar, Used
descriptionText: The Sun Coast McDonald's Plate from Christmas 2005 featuring the Hamburglar is a collectible advertising item representing the fast-food chain. This original plate with a multi-color design was manufactured in China and is a nostalgic piece for fans of McDonald's and collectors of restaurant memorabilia. It is a unique item that showcases a specific promotional campaign from the year 2005, making it a valuable addition to any collection of McDonald's memorabilia.
